rule.statement: A party whose presence is necessary for the effectual determination of all the issues involved in the case should be joined.
rule.supporting_quote: In order to avoid multiplicity of actions and to diminish the cost of litigation as pointed out by Ranasinghe, J., in Arumugam Coomaraswamy's case (Supra), and for the effective and complete adjudication and settlement of all questions involved in this case, the learned Trial Judge was correct when he made the order to add the 2nd respondent as a party defendant.
